justification: Standard: clears review flags on 12 instruments that gate whether citations read as current. Not Minor: a wrong clear would show stale law as current. Not Critical: the migration guards on the exact flagged count, the version dates reviewed and the instrument keys, and checks the remaining count; the 6 SEPPs with stale served rows stay flagged.

pre_impl.existing_data: On 2026-11-25 DQ-88 read 18. Paragraph diffs of all 18 in-force texts against their baselines: no land use table paragraph changed in the 12 LEPs; stored LEP-document rows holding changed wording: 6, none served; 6 SEPPs have 35 served rows holding changed wording.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: I expected most flags to need row refreshes; for LEPs we store only the land use table, so the flags clear on evidence and the SEPPs do not.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Same pattern as migrations 096 and 099: guarded clear with the evidence in the header, count asserted before and after.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The law site refuses this PC, so diffs ran inside Chrome on the site; a missing diff would leave the instrument flagged, never cleared.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A citation reads as current while the stored text is behind the law.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/apply_migration_dry_run.py migrations/128_dq88_clear_twelve_leps.sql --check "SELECT count(*) FROM instrument_registry WHERE is_active AND needs_review AND check_failures=0"; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-88
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The flagged count is not 18 before, not 6 after, or a SEPP with stale served rows is cleared.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The guard raises if the count before is not 18.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: Dry run checked 18 to 6; applied; the live probe reads 6.

functions.name: migration 128 update
functions.output: needs_review false for the 12 listed LEP keys at reviewed versions
functions.if_none: an unlisted or newer-version instrument stays flagged

functions.name: count guards
functions.input: the flagged count before and after
functions.output: raises unless it is 18 before and 6 after
functions.if_none: any other count aborts the transaction

values.read_at: the stored control text and the best matching sentence
values.if_missing: scores 0 and the control stays held

queries.purpose: Clear the review flag for 12 named LEP instruments only
queries.where_clause: is_active and needs_review, version_date on or before 2026-11-17, instrument_key in the 12 listed keys

break_it.scenario: An instrument is amended again before the migration runs.
break_it.what_happens: Its newer version_date would be cleared without review.
break_it.how: The update only matches version_date on or before 2026-11-17 and the count guard aborts on any other total.

break_it.scenario: A stored LEP row holds wording the law removed.
break_it.what_happens: The flag would hide a stale served rule.
break_it.how: All current rows of LEP documents were scanned for the removed paragraphs: 6 hits, none served.

break_it.scenario: One of the 6 SEPPs is cleared by mistake.
break_it.what_happens: Stale served rules would read as current.
break_it.how: The instrument key list names only LEPs and the final guard requires exactly 6 left.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-88 reads 6 (the migration is already applied to production).
